papers.title: Deep Reinforcement Learning with Massively Parallel Simulation for Low-Thrust Multi-Revolution Rendezvous
papers.summary: The growing demand for on-orbit servicing and constellation management in low Earth orbit requires autonomous and reliable low-thrust rendezvous. Traditional numerical methods struggle with the long-horizon nature of multi-revolution maneuvers under perturbations, while standard deep reinforcement learning (DRL) methods are limited by low simulation throughput and poor sample efficiency. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a massively parallel DRL guidance framework. A fully tensorized, GPU-resident orbital propagator is developed to integrate $J_2$-perturbed orbital dynamics and policy optimization within a zero-copy pipeline, achieving up to a 67-fold increase in simulation throughput over conventional CPU baselines. In addition, the rendezvous problem is formulated in modified equinoctial elements and trained with a progressive curriculum learning strategy to improve convergence and generalization across increasingly challenging rendezvous scenarios. Simulations show that the proposed framework can learn robust rendezvous trajectories for complex multi-revolution rendezvous over a broad range of orbital configurations. Additional evaluations under a high-fidelity model and eclipse-induced thrust interruptions further demonstrate the robustness of the learned policy under practical mission constraints. Moreover, the trajectories generated by the proposed framework can be used as effective initial guesses for optimization-based trajectory solvers, improving the convergence of high-precision trajectory optimization. The method offers a scalable approach for real-time low-thrust guidance and trajectory optimization.
papers.title_ja: 低推力多周回接近のための大規模並列シミュレーションを用いた深層強化学習
papers.summary_ja: 低軌道における自律的な低推力接近を目的に、GPU上で動作するテンソル化された軌道伝播器とゼロコピーパイプラインを構築し、シミュレーションスループットを従来比67倍に向上させた。修正黄道要素を用いた問題定式化と段階的カリキュラム学習により、多周回接近の収束性と汎化性能を改善した。高忠実度モデルや日食による推力中断下でも頑健性を示し、さらに生成軌道を最適化ソルバーの初期値として活用することで高精度軌道設計の収束を加速させる手法を提案している。
papers.relevance_reason: 低推力軌道設計とDRL、GPU高速化の組み合わせで関心領域と完全一致

papers.title: Graph-Based RL for Sequential Rendezvous Planning with Multiple Patrolling USVs
papers.summary: In patrol missions involving multiple unmanned surface vehicles (USVs), a designated command USV can support fleet management by sequentially rendezvousing with each patrolling USV. These operations require motion-feasible route planning and priority-aware rendezvous sequencing, with the objective of minimizing mission completion time and total tardiness relative to priority-dependent due dates. We propose a framework combining grid-based path planning, surrogate travel-time prediction, and graph-based reinforcement learning. The path planner accounts for ocean currents and approximates turn-rate constraints through multi-stage maneuvers, with path feasibility empirically validated through trajectory-tracking simulations. For rendezvous sequencing, a Feasible Transition Graph (FTG) represents candidate rendezvous events and temporally feasible transitions, enabling a graph neural network to exploit spatiotemporal rendezvous relationships for policy learning. A surrogate predicts travel times from compact current and motion features to avoid repeated path searches during FTG construction and policy training. Evaluation using grid-based path planning shows statistically significant average objective reductions of 10.5%, 3.5%, and 1.5% compared with greedy, MLP-RL, and 2-step lookahead greedy, respectively. The policy achieves these improvements while requiring approximately 1/35 of the latter's computation time. It maintains its advantage over MLP-RL under unseen priority-tier settings, with larger gains as fleet size increases.
papers.title_ja: 複数パトロールUSVの逐次ランデブー計画のためのグラフベース強化学習
papers.summary_ja: 複数の無人水面艇（USV）によるパトロール任務において、コマンド艇が各艇と順次ランデブーする計画問題を解決するフレームワークを提案する。海流や旋回制約を考慮したグリッドベース経路計画と、移動時間の予測サロゲートモデルを用いて、候補イベントと時間的に実行可能な遷移を表現する「実行可能遷移グラフ（FTG）」を構築する。このグラフ構造を活用したグラフニューラルネットワークによる強化学習ポリシーを学習し、優先度に応じた遅延と任務完了時間の最小化を実現する。評価では、貪欲法や通常のMLP-RLと比較して目標関数を大幅に削減し、計算時間は約1/35に短縮しながら、未知の優先度設定や大規模艦隊でも優れた汎化性能を示した。
papers.relevance_reason: RLとサロゲートモデルを組み合わせた経路最適化であり、ユーザーの関心と高度に一致

papers.title: Costate-Conditioned Dynamic Programming for Parallel-in-Time Solution of Equality-Constrained Optimal Control Problems
papers.summary: When interior-point methods are applied to solve numerical trajectory optimisation problems, they spend most of their per-iteration time on a structured Newton--KKT system, associated to an equality-constrained linear-quadratic optimal control problem. Riccati-type algorithms exhibit linear complexity in the trajectory horizon. Parallel-in-time algorithms are able to reduce this to logaritmic complexity by distributing several subtrajectories over multiple cores and then stitch together the results by means of an associative scan. Existing exact formulations condition each subtrajectory on its terminal state. Each subproblem then carries the reachability to that terminal state explicitly as constraint rows. The associated reachability decision however is ill-conditioned for weakly actuated systems. In this work we condition each subtrajectory on the terminal costate instead. The resulting subproblems can now be computed by a free-end Riccati recursion without reachability carrying rows. This approach effectively compensates for the ill-conditioning of weakly actuated systems but requires additional bookkeeping with Lagrangian multipliers when stitching together the various subproblems. Numerically the method reproduces a direct solution of the primal-dual Newton-KKT system to $10^{-12}$ in relative terms, on a weakly controllable chain of masses, the accurracy rivals that of a sequential recursion, whereas terminal-state conditioning loses up to six digits or fails. Operation counts on a problem with 64 subtrajectories and a horizon of 4096 stages gives a speed-up of 26 compared with a sequential solve.
papers.title_ja: 等式制約付き最適制御問題の時系列並列解法におけるコストート条件付き動的計画法
papers.summary_ja: 軌道最適化におけるニュートン法計算のボトルネックであるKKT系の解法を、時系列並列化により高速化する手法を提案する。従来の終端状態条件付けが弱制御系で数値的に不安定になる問題を、終端コストート（共役変数）条件付けに置き換えることで解決する。これにより、リーカティ再帰を用いた安定なサブ問題計算が可能となり、弱制御系でも高精度な解を得られる。64サブトラジェクト・4096ステージの問題で、逐次解法比26倍の高速化を実証した。
papers.relevance_reason: 軌道最適化の高速化と数値計算手法の改善であり、ユーザーの関心と高度に一致する。

papers.title: Can Time Series Foundation Models Serve as Surrogates for Power Systems Dynamic Simulation?
papers.summary: High-fidelity dynamic simulation is essential for scientific and engineering applications, but its computational cost limits large-scale scenario screening. We investigate the use of pretrained time-series foundation models (TSFMs) as computationally efficient surrogates to address this limitation. In-context learning and post-training strategies, including retrieval-augmented reference sample selection and physics-informed regularization, are considered in the investigation. Results are benchmarked against a traditional AI model representative of the state-of-the-art in the domain. Experiments using an open-source TSFM and data from a simulated 9-bus power system indicate promising results. Retrieval augmentation improves in-context learning performance, and fine-tuning leads to superior results compared to the traditional AI model, especially when including physics-informed regularization. The fine-tuned TSFMs achieve lower errors and improved computational costs compared to the traditional AI model, and a 563$\times$ speedup compared to the original physics-based simulation.
papers.title_ja: 時系列基盤モデルは電力システムの動的シミュレーションのサロゲートとして機能し得るか？
papers.summary_ja: 本研究では、計算コストの高い電力システムの高精度動的シミュレーションを代替する目的で、事前学習済みの時系列基盤モデル（TSFM）の活用を調査した。コンテキスト学習や、検索拡張（RAG）および物理情報正則化を用いたポストトレーニング戦略を評価し、従来の最先端AIモデルと比較した。実験の結果、検索拡張はコンテキスト学習の性能を向上させ、物理情報正則化を含むファインチューニングにより、従来のAIモデルを上回る精度と計算効率を実現した。最終的に、元の物理ベースシミュレーションに対して563倍の高速化を達成した。
papers.relevance_reason: サロゲートモデル、物理情報、RAG、高速化の全要素が関心に一致

papers.title: All roads lead to Markov kernel networks: A representation theorem for discretization-stable learning
papers.summary: Operator learning seeks to approximate function-to-function maps in a way that remains stable when the input discretization changes, a property sometimes called "discretization invariance". We consider a quantitative refinement of this idea, called $\textit{uniform discretization stability}$, which builds on a common representation of input functions and their discretizations as probability measures and provides a H\"older bound relating output changes to the Wasserstein distance between these measures. Our main result is a representation theorem showing all uniformly discretization stable operators can be written exactly as a $\textit{stable Markov kernel network}$---an abstract architecture that is a joint generalization of transformers, Fourier neural operators (FNO), Flowers, and other successful learned operators. Our representation theorem characterizes a design space for discretization-stable operator learning; designing new architectures becomes a question of which parts of a Markov kernel network to parameterize, and how. We further show that the read kernels of these networks can be realized as solutions of regularized variational problems, with particular choices of costs and regularizers recovering the kernels of transformers, FNO, Flowers, their hybrids, and beyond. This variational formulation provides a systematic approach to architecture design, together with sufficient conditions for uniform discretization stability.
papers.title_ja: すべての道はマルコフカーネルネットワークに通じる：離散化安定学習のための表現定理
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、入力離散化の変化に対して安定したオペレータ学習（ニューラルオペレータなど）の理論的基盤を確立する。著者らは「均一離散化安定性」を定量化し、この性質を持つすべてのオペレータが「安定マルコフカーネルネットワーク」として厳密に表現可能であることを示す。この表現定理により、トランスフォーマーやフーリエニューラルオペレータ（FNO）などの既存アーキテクチャが統一された設計空間として捉えられ、パラメータ化戦略の選択がアーキテクチャ設計の核心となる。さらに、これらのカーネルが正則化された変分問題の解として実現可能であることを示し、体系的なアーキテクチャ設計手法を提供する。
papers.relevance_reason: ニューラルオペレータの理論的統一と設計原理を提示し、サロゲートモデルの高度化に直結する。

papers.title: Ensemble Routing for Prompt-Adaptive Cost-Aware LLM Inference
papers.summary: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly support Web-based services that must balance response quality and inference cost across heterogeneous requests. Conventional routing selects one model per prompt, while fixed ensembles cannot adapt their composition and cost to individual requests. We introduce PISA, a prompt-adaptive, cost-aware single-model router, and PISA-E, its extension to ensemble routing. At the core of both methods, PISA combines soft cluster memberships with model-specific predictors to estimate individual model capabilities. Building on these estimates, PISA-E jointly selects ensemble composition and cardinality under an explicit cost--quality preference that can be adjusted at inference time without retraining. A tractable ensemble-success surrogate and efficient candidate selection enable this extension without ensemble-specific training. Across four LLM routing benchmarks under in-distribution (ID) and out-of-distribution (OOD) conditions, PISA achieves the highest macro-average cost--performance hypervolume among the evaluated single-model routers in both settings. Meanwhile, PISA-E achieves the highest macro-average task performance among the evaluated ensemble approaches when prioritizing response quality, surpassing the strongest competitors by 2.09 and 2.87 percentage points under ID and OOD conditions, respectively. At selected lower-cost operating points, it also exceeds the strongest ensemble competitors' macro-average task performance while reducing average inference cost by approximately 36% and 25%, respectively. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of prompt-adaptive capability estimation for both single-model routing and selective ensembling.
papers.title_ja: プロンプト適応型コスト意識LLM推論のためのアンサンブルルーティング
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、LLM推論におけるコストと品質のバランスを最適化するためのプロンプト適応型ルーティング手法PISAと、そのアンサンブル拡張版PISA-Eを提案する。PISAはソフトクラスタリングとモデル固有の予測子を用いて個別モデルの能力を推定し、PISA-Eは推論時にコストと品質の優先度を調整可能にしながらアンサンブルの構成と規模を最適選択する。4つのベンチマークにおいて、単一モデルルーティングでは最高レベルのコストパフォーマンス、アンサンブル手法では品質重視時に競合を上回る性能、低コスト設定では約25〜36%のコスト削減を実現した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM推論の効率化・コスト最適化・ルーティング設計に直結する

papers.title: Rethinking How to Leverage Cheap Physics for Data-Efficient Neural Operators
papers.summary: Neural operators learn mappings from PDE inputs, such as initial conditions and coefficient fields, to the corresponding solutions. Once trained, they can rapidly predict solutions for new inputs. However, obtaining input-solution pairs for supervised training often requires expensive numerical simulations, whereas PDE inputs and governing equations provide inexpensive physical information. This raises a question: how can cheap physical information reduce the need for labeled solutions? A natural approach is to use physics to select inputs for labeling, but our acquisition experiments show no consistent advantage over random sampling. This observation motivates exploring an alternative: using cheap physics to improve neural operator initialization before supervised training. We propose Physics-Informed Initialization (PI-Init), a simple yet effective method that pretrains neural operators on unlabeled inputs using physics-informed losses and retains the learned parameters for supervised fine-tuning on the labeled dataset. A linearized analysis shows that pretraining can improve downstream prediction accuracy by reducing initialization errors that limited labeled data cannot effectively correct. Experiments across diverse PDE benchmarks and neural operator architectures demonstrate improvements in predictive accuracy, out-of-distribution generalization, and label efficiency. Representative results show error reductions of up to 62.7% at the same label budget and comparable or better accuracy with 90% fewer labels, relative to supervised-only training.
papers.title_ja: 安価な物理情報を用いたデータ効率の良いニューラルオペレータの活用方法の再考
papers.summary_ja: ニューラルオペレータの学習において、高コストな数値シミュレーションによるラベルデータへの依存を減らす手法を提案する。物理情報を用いた入力選択には一貫した利点がないことを示し、代わりに物理情報損失関数を用いた事前学習（PI-Init）による初期化改善に焦点を当てる。この手法により、ラベルデータが限られる状況でも初期化誤差を低減し、予測精度と分布外汎化性能を向上させる。実験では、ラベル数を90%削減しても同等以上の精度を維持し、最大62.7%の誤差低減効果が確認された。
papers.relevance_reason: ニューラルオペレータと物理情報、データ効率化の交点であり関心と一致

papers.title: TORNADO: Adaptive Latent Stochastic Transport for Calibrated Probabilistic PDE Forecasting
papers.summary: Probabilistic neural surrogates for PDEs enable ensemble forecasting, but often exhibit miscalibration when used for uncertainty quantification, especially in compute-constrained, few-step inference regimes. Existing generative approaches typically rely on fixed global stochasticity, which cannot adapt predictive uncertainty to the local dynamical state. We propose TORNADO, a latent probabilistic forecasting framework that formulates next-step prediction as stochastic transport between VAE encoder posteriors. Unlike existing approaches with globally prescribed stochasticity, TORNADO learns a SDE with state-dependent diffusion, enabling the predictive uncertainty to adapt to the local latent dynamics. The model is trained using analytic conditional endpoint targets derived from a Gaussian interpolant, enabling simulation-free learning. An additional energy distance regularization term improves distributional alignment. Empirically, TORNADO improves uncertainty calibration over representative generative baselines, including stochastic interpolants, diffusion models, and flow matching, while maintaining comparable predictive accuracy. Our results show that adapting stochasticity to the latent state, rather than prescribing it globally, is an effective mechanism for improving calibration in practical neural PDE forecasting settings. Project page: https://tornado-sde.github.io.
papers.title_ja: TORNADO: 較正された確率的PDE予測のための適応型潜在確率輸送
papers.summary_ja: PDEの確率的ニューラルサロゲートにおいて、計算制約下での較正不足を解決するため、VAEのポスター分布間の確率輸送をSDEとして定式化するフレームワークTORNADOを提案する。既存手法の固定的なグローバル確率性とは異なり、状態依存の拡散項を学習することで、局所的な動的状態に応じて予測の不確実性を適応的に調整する。ガウス補間から導出される解析的条件終点ターゲットを用いることで、シミュレーション不要な学習を実現し、エネルギー距離の正則化により分布の整合性を向上させる。拡散モデルやフローマッチングなどのベースラインと比較し、予測精度を維持しつつ不確実性の較正性能を大幅に改善することを示した。
papers.relevance_reason: PDE予測のサロゲートモデルと確率的不確実性処理は、ユーザーの関心であるサロゲートモデル・物理情報ニューラルネットの高度な応用分野に該当するため。

papers.title: Dynamic State Estimation from Sparse PMUs via Physics-Informed Graph Neural Operators
papers.summary: This paper proposes a physics-informed graph neural operator for power system dynamic state estimation. From a sparse, intermittent measurement window at a few generator buses, the operator estimates the rotor-angle and speed trajectories of all machines, unmeasured ones included, in one forward pass. A graph-attention encoder processes the measurements, and the swing equations are imposed as a hard constraint or as a soft one with a learned correction that absorbs model errors. It is trained on simulated measurements, without state labels. With several phasor measurement units, masked training hides one from the input but keeps it in the loss. On four transmission systems, simulations show that the operator is the most accurate estimator that neither optimizes per scenario nor uses state labels, except on the smallest system at large model errors, where tuned Kalman smoothers are better. Networks trained on simulated states are more accurate on the two smallest systems but not on the 118-bus system, where the operator is faster and more accurate than hard-constrained moving-horizon estimation. Under model errors, it matches or outperforms an optimization-based benchmark at a fraction of its cost. The results hold for a detailed machine model with exact parameters seen only through voltage phasors.
papers.title_ja: 物理情報グラフニューラルオペレータを用いたスパースPMUからの動的状態推定
papers.summary_ja: 電力システムの動的状態推定において、少数の発電機バスからのスパースなPMU測定値から、全発電機のロータ角度・速度軌道を1回の順伝播で推定する物理情報グラフニューラルオペレータを提案する。スイング方程式をハードまたはソフト制約として組み込み、状態ラベルなしでシミュレーションデータから学習する。4つの送電システムでのシミュレーションにより、最適化ベースの手法やカルマンスムーサーと比較し、モデル誤差下でも低コストで高精度な推定が可能であることを示した。特に118バスシステムでは、ハード制約付き動的最適化手法よりも高速かつ高精度であることが確認された。
papers.relevance_reason: 物理情報ニューラルオペレータとスパースデータからの状態推定という関心領域に完全一致

papers.title: PatternBloom: Empowering Agentic RAG with Externalized RL-Distilled Graph Patterns
papers.summary: Reinforcement-learning-trained agents for retrieval-augmented generation retrieve content (passages, knowledge-graph fragments, or hyperedges) and supervise training with outcome rewards on the final answer. Across these paradigms the reasoning route through retrieved content never leaves the language model's hidden state, conflating declarative knowledge with the procedural knowledge that recurs across queries of the same logical type; content-only methods consequently plateau as reasoning depth grows. We introduce PatternBloom, an agentic RAG framework that shifts the unit of retrieval from content (what to read) to logic (how to reason). A first RL stage scores the agent's constructed evidence graph by a frozen oracle's information gain through the Information-Density Reward (IDR), a size-normalized mutual-information surrogate. High-reward trajectories are distilled into a Graph Pattern Memory (GPM) of type-abstracted reasoning skeletons, and a second RL stage uses the Pattern-Augmented Reward (PAR) to couple policy to memory, turning procedural reasoning into a learnable, externalized structural prior. A 7B PatternBloom outperforms $27$ baselines by $+15.0$ Avg-OOD EM, with the gain compounding with reasoning depth precisely because procedural knowledge, once distilled, is reused rather than re-derived at every query. We release our code at https://github.com/EllenYiGe/PatternBloom.
papers.title_ja: PatternBloom: 外部化された強化学習蒸留グラフパターンによるエージェント型RAGの強化
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、検索拡張生成（RAG）における推論プロセスを言語モデルの隠れ状態から外部メモリへ移すことで、推論深度の増加に伴う性能低下を解決するフレームワーク「PatternBloom」を提案する。強化学習（RL）を用いて証拠グラフの情報を評価し、高報酬の推論経路を抽象化された「グラフパターンメモリ（GPM）」として蒸留・蓄積する。この外部化された手続き的知識（プロシージャルナレッジ）を再利用することで、7Bモデルが27種のベースラインを上回り、特に深い推論タスクで+15.0の平均EM向上を実現した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMのエージェント設計とRAG、強化学習の応用が関心と一致

papers.title: Floquet-Parameterized Koopman-MPC for Tracking Periodic Orbits
papers.summary: Designing real-time control for nonlinear systems to track periodic orbits can be challenging, especially for complex and coupled dynamical systems (e.g., tethered kites), where the true model parameters are hard to obtain. To address this, we propose a physics-informed Koopman learning approach that incorporates periodic-orbit stability directly into the learned linear predictor. The approach combines the underlying periodic structure of the dynamics along with periodic state-input trajectory data to learn physically consistent linear predictors (in lifted/observable space). We leverage Floquet theory, which studies the stability of periodic orbits in nonlinear systems, to obtain the periodic stability information of a given orbit via a monodromy matrix (i.e., the state transition matrix over an entire period). Subsequently, we impose open-loop monodromy constraints to learn Floquet-parameterized linear predictors using a least-squares Extended Dynamic Mode Decomposition (EDMD) formulation, thereby constraining the search space and aiding in Koopman learning. We then utilize these linear predictors to design a model predictive control (MPC) law for tracking periodic references. Finally, we evaluate the designed framework on a cartpole system under periodic forcing and compare it against a purely data-driven baseline.
papers.title_ja: 周期軌道の追従のためのFloquetパラメータ化Koopman-MPC
papers.summary_ja: 非線形システムの周期軌道追従制御において、物理情報Koopman学習手法を提案する。Floquet理論に基づく単一周回行列（モノドロミー行列）の制約を最小二乗EDMDに組み込むことで、物理的に整合した線形予測器を学習する。この予測器を用いてモデル予測制御（MPC）を設計し、周期参照軌道の追従を実現する。カートポールシステムでの実験により、純粋なデータ駆動型ベースラインと比較して有効性を示した。
papers.relevance_reason: 物理情報ニューラルネットと軌道力学・制御の融合であり、関心領域に直結する。

papers.title: MarsNet: Learning the Martian Atmosphere from Observations Alone
papers.summary: We present MarsNet, a machine-learned model of the Martian atmosphere trained only on observations. Existing reanalyses assimilate spacecraft retrievals into general circulation models (GCMs), so where observations are sparse their fields largely reflect the model. We therefore use extant reanalyses only for evaluation. MarsNet alternates a two-hour forecast with an update that assimilates the observations of each window, and both steps are learned jointly. Because the Martian record is too sparse for an unrestricted network, learning is confined within a fixed physical structure: the state is in physical units, the forecast uses physical tendencies of fixed form and learned strength, and the update is a bounded Kalman update. MarsNet is trained on Mars Years (MY) 24--31 and evaluated on independent observations. On three seasons of MGS radio-occultation temperatures assimilated by no dataset, MarsNet matches or improves on the three reanalyses in the lowest three scale heights, with a near-surface root-mean-square error (RMSE) of 4.2 K against 4.4--5.4 K, but is less accurate aloft. The model's surface pressures are the most accurate of the four products (RMSE 10 Pa against Curiosity in MY32, compared with 20--46 Pa). On withheld Mars Climate Sounder profiles of MY32, its temperatures beat an observed climatology and persistence, including in ten-sol forecasts without new observations, and its stated uncertainty is close to calibrated. Much of the temperature skill is present before training and appears to come from the structure and tables fitted to the observations, while training mainly improves the surface pressures, at some cost to dust. The model cycles stably through nine Mars years, and the influence of each observation can be traced. Its speed makes experiments on the observing record practical, and it offers an independent reference for GCMs and reanalyses.
papers.title_ja: MarsNet: 観測データのみから火星大気を学習するモデル
papers.summary_ja: MarsNetは、既存の再解析データではなく観測データのみを用いて訓練された火星大気の機械学習モデルである。物理構造を固定した枠組み内で、予測と観測同化を交互に行う学習手法を採用し、既存の再解析データセットと比較して地表付近の温度や圧力の精度を向上させた。特に地表圧力のRMSEが既存手法より低く、10日間の予測でも観測気候平均を上回る性能を示した。このモデルはGCMや再解析に対する独立した参照系として機能し、観測記録の実験を高速に行うことを可能にする。

papers.title: PIA: Agentic Physics-Informed Runtime Anomaly Detection
papers.summary: Runtime anomaly detectors for cyber-physical systems are either learned as black boxes from normal data, which miss stealthy manipulations that keep every signal inside its normal range, or derived by hand from physical models, which requires expert effort for every plant. We introduce physicsinformed agents (PIA), in which a large language model agent writes the detector itself as a set of physical residuals, such as pump characteristics, tank mass balances, and controller logic, and refines every candidate against normal operating data through an evaluation workbench before deployment. The result is a compact, human-readable detector that runs in milliseconds and names the component behind each alarm. On the BATADAL water distribution attack benchmark, PIA with Claude Opus 5.5 reaches an F1 of 0.878 on the test attacks against 0.504 for the strongest of six statistical and deep baselines, keeps detecting attacks concealed by replayed and offset sensor readings, and attributes every detected test attack to the attacked component. Ablations show that testing hypotheses against data is decisive: agents that write residuals from the plant description alone lose up to 0.28 F1, whereas agents that see only anonymized signals recover most of the physical structure.
papers.title_ja: PIA: エージェント型物理情報ランタイム異常検出
papers.summary_ja: サイバーフィジカルシステムにおけるランタイム異常検出において、LLMエージェントが物理モデルに基づく残差式を自動生成・改善する手法PIAを提案する。この手法は、正常範囲内でのステルス攻撃を検出でき、かつ人間が読めるコンパクトな検出器をミリ秒単位で実行できる。BATADAL水配給システム攻撃ベンチマークにおいて、既存の統計的・深層学習ベースラインを大幅に上回るF1スコア0.878を達成し、攻撃元コンポーネントの特定にも成功した。アブレーション実験により、仮説をデータで検証するプロセスが検出性能に決定的に重要であることが示された。

papers.title: Selected-Risk Calibration for Feasibility at Returned Decisions
papers.summary: When an optimization problem uses a surrogate constraint, a decision that is feasible for the surrogate need not be feasible for the true constraint. We propose Selected-Risk Calibration (SRC), a framework that calibrates a learned constraint against the optimizer's returned decisions for objectives drawn from a given distribution. SRC guarantees that, with probability at least $1-\delta$, every margin it certifies on held-out objectives has selected risk, the probability that the returned decision is infeasible, of at most $\gamma$. We also show that the random-input coverage guarantee of split conformal prediction does not bound the selected risk, and that likelihood-ratio reweighting for feedback covariate shift does not apply when the learned constraint is active at the returned decision. Our experiments show that a conformal margin covering about $90\%$ of random inputs covered as few as $17\%$ of the returned decisions, and every certified margin had a violation rate below its target on unseen objectives. Moreover, at equal cost, SRC's correction had fewer or equal infeasible solutions to the baselines in 57 of 62 comparisons. The SRC framework applies to any setting in which a surrogate model chooses a decision whose feasibility can be verified for a sample of instances.
papers.title_ja: 返却決定における実現可能性のための選択リスク較正
papers.summary_ja: サロゲートモデルを用いた最適化において、サロゲート上では実現可能だが真の制約では不可行となる決定に対するリスクを制御するフレームワーク「Selected-Risk Calibration (SRC)」を提案する。SRCは、与えられた確率保証のもとで、最適化器が返却した決定に対する選択リスク（不可行確率）を上限値以下に抑えることを保証する。従来の分割共形予測や尤度比重み付けではこのリスクを適切に制御できないことを示し、SRCが同等のコストでより少ない不可行解を生成することを実験で実証した。
papers.relevance_reason: サロゲートモデルと最適化の組み合わせ、リスク制御手法が関心に直結

papers.title: Transferring local rib responses to new component geometries in sheet forming with a graph-based Transformer
papers.summary: Sheet metal components often consist of a global geometry, such as the corner radii and forming depth of a corner component, and local features added to it. During forming, both affect material flow. A surrogate learning all their combinations may need large training data. However, the same local feature type is often used on many global geometries. This study therefore partly decouples local features from the global geometry. The local-feature effect is first learned on one global geometry, needing fewer simulations than learning all combinations, then transferred to other global geometries via transfer learning, which can need fewer target simulations than training from scratch. A baseline-conditioned residual surrogate, R-BiLoGo, is proposed for ribs on the side walls of hot-stamped corner components. Its inputs are the baseline response and the geometric perturbation introduced by the ribs. Its outputs are the changes in displacement and thinning from the baseline. R-BiLoGo gave lower errors than a hierarchical graph-based model and a Transolver-based model on the source geometry, and on two of three selected target geometries after transfer. Across the 22 target geometries, transfer learning with 20 target simulations gave errors similar to or lower than training from scratch with 80 target simulations for about half of the targets. With the same 80 target simulations, transfer learning reduced errors for 95% of targets. The effect of the global geometry on transfer was studied with four parameter-free geometric descriptors and controlled variations across 4 corner subclasses. The benefit of transfer decreased with increasing surface distance and high-curvature change between source and target, and for targets shallower than the source. These trends were also seen in other corner types with a different magnitude.
papers.title_ja: シート成形におけるリブの局所応答をグラフベースTransformerを用いて新しい部品幾何形状へ転移させる手法
papers.summary_ja: 金属板成形におけるリブ（局所特徴）と全体形状の効果を分離し、転移学習により少ないシミュレーションデータでサロゲートモデルを構築する手法を提案する。ベースライン条件付き残差サロゲートR-BiLoGoを用いることで、ソース形状での学習後にターゲット形状へ応答を転移させ、従来手法より低い誤差を実現した。22種のターゲット形状において、転移学習は80回のシミュレーションによるゼロショット学習と比較し、同等以上の精度を20回程度のデータで達成できることを示した。全体形状との距離や曲率変化が大きいほど転移の効果が低下する傾向も確認された。
papers.relevance_reason: サロゲートモデルと転移学習による計算効率化が関心に合致

papers.title: Match the Geometry Before the Surrogate: Extreme Low-Budget Optimization in High Dimensions
papers.summary: Low-budget molecular optimization is often framed as Bayesian optimization in a learned latent space, but standard benchmarks typically allow hundreds or thousands of evaluations, whereas a realistic wet-lab round may allow only a few dozen. We revisit this regime using a SELFIES molecular variational autoencoder (VAE) with a Gaussian prior and GuacaMol objectives at N = 30 evaluations. The main finding is not a new surrogate model, but an interaction in candidate generation. The encoder means of a reference set of molecules concentrate near a narrow spherical shell, while many high-dimensional optimizers propose candidates from boxes or box-shaped trust regions. We study a simple constraint, the on-sphere scaffold, that restricts candidate generation to this shell. We then introduce two minimal optimizers to probe what remains useful once the support is fixed. GeoWalk performs geodesic local search on the shell without a surrogate. After 30 evaluations, it shows no detected difference from a Gaussian-process (GP) surrogate on the shell, which is ahead earlier in the budget. GeoCMA adds covariance learning in a random subspace. It does not improve on GeoWalk in the molecular benchmark. On LassoBench it has a lower mean loss than GeoWalk, but full-dimensional CMA-ES remains stronger on most tasks. A factorial experiment with a single GP crosses the candidate support (shell or box) with the acquisition maximizer (a finite candidate set or a continuous optimizer). In this benchmark, shell candidates outperformed box candidates when acquisition was maximized over a candidate set, but not with continuous maximization by L-BFGS-B. These results come from a controlled study of one Gaussian-prior VAE benchmark and do not recommend VAEs for molecular optimization. The practical lesson is to control the candidate support and the acquisition maximizer before attributing a gain to the surrogate.
papers.title_ja: サロゲートモデルの前に幾何学を合わせる：高次元における極低予算最適化
papers.summary_ja: 分子最適化において、評価回数が極めて少ない（N=30）条件下で、サロゲートモデルよりも候補生成の幾何学的制約が重要であることを示す。VAEの潜在空間では分子が球殻上に集中するため、この「オン・スフィア」制約を課した最適化手法（GeoWalk, GeoCMA）を提案した。実験の結果、サロゲートモデルの有無よりも、候補空間の形状と取得関数の最大化手法の組み合わせが性能に大きく影響することが判明した。本論文は、低予算環境下での機械学習ベース最適化において、モデル選択よりも問題構造の理解と制約設計が優先されるべきという実務的な知見を提供する。
papers.relevance_reason: 低予算最適化とサロゲートモデル設計の相互作用を分析し、ML手法の実務的改善に直結する。

papers.title: Applied bifidelity material response model construction and uncertainty quantification with a sampling hypernetwork
papers.summary: Multifidelity modeling offers a practical route to accurate prediction and uncertainty quantification when high-fidelity data are scarce but lower-fidelity data are comparatively abundant. This work develops a bifidelity Langevin sampling hypernetwork framework that constructs probabilistic neu- ral response models by learning a posterior distribution over model parameters rather than a single deterministic fit. The method combines a flexible shared-latent data representation for low- and high-fidelity responses, enabling parameter sharing and transfer learning between the fidelities. We introduce several methodological enhancements to improve the robustness and efficiency of this ap- proach, including stability-promoting drift models, staged and conditional training strategies, adap- tive initialization of Langevin trajectories, and training procedures designed to better exploit corre- lations between fidelity levels. These additions improve convergence behavior, reduce the sampling effort required to obtain representative posterior ensembles, and provide more reliable predictive uncertainty in data-limited regimes. The resulting framework makes more effective use of available multifidelity data while preserving interpretability through the learned posterior structure, yielding improved predictive performance, better uncertainty characterization, and a more stable workflow for constructing uncertainty-aware surrogate models. The method is demonstrated on experimental, high-fidelity simulation and illustrative synthetic data.
papers.title_ja: サンプリングハイパーネットワークを用いた応用バイフィデリティ材料応答モデル構築と不確実性定量化
papers.summary_ja: 高忠実度データが限られる状況で、低忠実度データを活用し確率的なニューラル応答モデルを構築するバイフィデリティ・ランジュバンサンプリングハイパーネットワークフレームワークを提案する。モデルパラメータの事後分布を学習することで、単一の決定論的フィッティングを超えた予測不確実性の定量化を実現する。安定化ドリフトモデルや段階的学習戦略などの手法的改善により、収束性とサンプリング効率を向上させ、データ限定的な環境でも信頼性の高いサロゲートモデルを構築可能にする。実験データや高忠実度シミュレーションを用いて、予測性能と不確実性特性の改善を実証している。

papers.title: Spectral Bias Reduction in Local Gated ReLU Architectures
papers.summary: Neural networks trained by gradient-based methods learn the low-frequency content of a target function faster than its high-frequency content. This spectral bias is well documented, but it is much less clear which architectural choices mitigate it and which cannot. We study the question for shallow ReLU models linear in their trainable parameters, where each mode is learned at a rate given by a Gram-matrix eigenvalue, and for a general symmetric bilinear form $a(\cdot,\cdot)$, so that least-squares regression ($a=$ the $L^2$ inner product) and variational or physics-informed losses ($a=$ the $H^1$ energy form) are two instances of one analysis. Within this framework we propose gated local ReLU dictionaries, obtained by multiplying each ReLU feature by a hat partition-of-unity weight, in the spirit of partition-of-unity finite elements and overlapping Schwarz methods. The resulting Gram matrices are block-banded for any local bilinear form, with a block-Toeplitz interior whose matrix-valued symbol governs the spectrum. The two forms then behave very differently. For $L^2$ regression, the symbol is bounded away from zero, the ratio is uniform in the number of windows, and the measured spread of frequency-dependent learning rates falls from $1.9\times10^{5}$ to $4.5$ at matched model size. For the $H^1$ stiffness matrix, the symbol vanishes at zero frequency: gating leaves the $\Theta(N^2)$ conditioning intact and inverts the frequency ordering instead of removing the bias. A preconditioner built from the same interior stencil will fix the spectral bias, showing that architecture alone is not enough. Experiments on $1$D regression and Poisson problems confirm the dichotomy, and the regression effect persists when the hidden-layer parameters are trained as well.
papers.title_ja: 局所ゲート付きReLUアーキテクチャにおけるスペクトルバイアスの低減
papers.summary_ja: 勾配法による学習における低周波数優先のスペクトルバイアスを、局所ゲート付きReLU辞書を用いて分析・低減する手法を提案する。L2回帰では周波数依存学習率のばらつきが大幅に縮小される一方、H1エネルギー形式（物理情報損失など）ではバイアスが逆転し、事前条件付けが必要であることが示された。1次元回帰およびポアソン問題での実験により、アーキテクチャ単独では不十分であり、適切な前処理が重要であることが確認された。

papers.title: Two-Timescale Trajectory Control, Task Reassignment and Resource Scheduling for Multi-UAV Cooperative Mobile Edge Computing
papers.summary: Uncrewed aerial vehicle (UAV)-assisted mobile edge computing (MEC) is a promising technology, leveraging the advantages of UAVs including flexible deployment, wide coverage, and reliable wireless communication. In this paper, we study the task reassignment and offloading problem in a multi-UAV cooperative operating environment, and consider the real occurrence that the computing tasks arrive more frequently than UAVs make flight decisions. In addition, we also take into account the position offset of the UAV during flight and the unavailability of the UAV due to external interference. We propose a two-timescale optimization framework, where the trajectory of the UAV is carried out on a large timescale, while the task reassignment and computing resource allocation are jointly optimized on a small timescale. The core objective is to maximize the long-term average system gain, which takes both energy consumption and task delay into account. To address the UAV trajectory optimization problem under large timescale constraints, we propose a constrained multi-agent deep reinforcement learning algorithm. For decision-making within small timescale, to jointly optimize task offloading decisions and computing resource allocation, we integrate convex optimization with a heuristic algorithm. Finally, we conduct extensive simulations to evaluate the proposed algorithms against the baseline, achieving a 24% reduction in latency and a 28% reduction in total system cost.
papers.title_ja: マルチUAV協調モバイルエッジコンピューティングにおける二時間スケールの軌道制御、タスク再割り当て、リソーススケジューリング
papers.summary_ja: マルチUAV協調モバイルエッジコンピューティング環境におけるタスクオフローディングとリソース割り当て問題を解決するため、二時間スケールの最適化フレームワークを提案する。大時間スケールではUAVの軌道最適化を、小時間スケールではタスク再割り当てと計算リソース配分をそれぞれ行う。軌道制御には制約付きマルチエージェント強化学習アルゴリズムを適用し、小時間スケールの決定には凸最適化とヒューリスティックアルゴリズムを統合する。シミュレーションにより、レイテンシ24%削減とシステムコスト28%削減の効果を実証した。

papers.title: Why fluid relaxation modes matter: Nonlinear frequency response, dynamical integrity, and dynamic pull-in of electrostatic microbeams with squeeze-film damping
papers.summary: The squeeze film between an electrostatically actuated microbeam can both induce damping and add stiffness to the structure. In addition, the dynamics of the film can interact with the nonlinear response of the microbeam. This paper extends a reduced-order model built on the complex modes of the coupled fluid-structure problem to the computation of periodic responses and their stability for clamped-clamped microbeams. Periodic orbits are continued in the frequency domain, and their stability is determined from their Floquet multipliers. The robustness of the response is assessed through basins of attraction, integrity measures, and dynamic pull-in maps in the plane of the excitation parameters. The model is validated against the measured and computed frequency response of a microswitch. Closed-form expressions are derived for the fluid relaxation modes, together with a correction for strongly coupled films, and define a parameter that characterizes the regime of the film. The approach is applied to different microbeams including cases where fluid modes relax on the timescale of the oscillation. For all simulated devices, a single fluid mode is necessary and sufficient, whereas adding coupled modes cannot replace it, whether the fluid modes respond quasi-statically or carry their own dynamics. Removing the fluid mode displaces both bifurcations that bound the pull-in band, changes the size of the basins of attraction and the position of the attractor within them, misses an abrupt erosion of the safe basin under increasing excitation, and shifts the whole region of dynamic pull-in in the excitation plane. The reduced model, with three real unknowns, makes these global analyses affordable for a fully coupled fluid-structure system.
papers.title_ja: 流体緩和モードの重要性：スクイーズフィルム減衰を伴う静電マイクロビームの非線形周波数応答、動的完全性、および動的プルイン
papers.summary_ja: 静電アクチュエーションマイクロビームにおける流体-構造結合系の非線形応答を解析する研究である。複素モードに基づく縮約モデルを用い、Floquet乗数やアトラクタの盆地を通じて周期的軌道の安定性と動的プルイン現象を評価した。流体緩和モードの存在が分岐点や安全盆地のサイズに与える影響を定量的に示し、単一の流体モードが系全体の挙動を支配することを明らかにした。この手法により、完全結合系に対する大域的な安定性解析を低コストで実現可能にした。

papers.title: Direct Trajectory Optimization for Inference-Time Alignment of Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
papers.summary: Alignment of text-to-image diffusion models with reward functions is a key challenge in controllable generation. Existing approaches typically rely on optimizing model inputs or fine-tuning denoising networks, which requires computationally expensive backpropagation through large denoising models. In this work, we propose Direct Trajectory Optimization (DTO), a training-free framework that performs alignment by directly optimizing the sampling trajectory of diffusion models. Specifically, DTO treats intermediate denoising scores and sampled noise as the optimization variables, eliminating the need for gradients through the denoising network. To mitigate the out-of-distribution problem, we introduce Reward-Optimized Score Guidance, which interpolates between the optimized scores and the pretrained model predictions to stabilize sampling, while providing a provable theoretical guarantee of reward improvement under constrained distributions. Empirically, DTO improves alignment performance across three diffusion models on two benchmarks, outperforming existing inference-time alignment methods while maintaining high efficiency. These results suggest that trajectory-level optimization is a promising direction for efficient and effective diffusion model alignment.
papers.title_ja: テキストから画像への拡散モデルの推論時アライメントのための直接軌道最適化
papers.summary_ja: テキストから画像への拡散モデルにおいて、報酬関数とのアライメントを推論時に行う手法「Direct Trajectory Optimization (DTO)」を提案する。既存手法が大きなデノイジングネットワークへの逆伝播を必要とするのに対し、本手法はサンプリング軌道自体を最適化変数として扱い、ネットワークの勾配計算を不要にする。さらに、分布外問題を緩和するため、最適化されたスコアと事前学習モデルの予測を補間するReward-Optimized Score Guidanceを導入し、理論的な保証も示している。実験では、3つの拡散モデルと2つのベンチマークにおいて、既存の推論時アライメント手法を上回る性能と効率を達成した。

papers.title: Satellite Streaks in HETDEX: Spectra, Orbital Identification, and Survey Impact
papers.summary: We present a spectroscopic database and analysis of satellite streaks in Public Data Release 1 (PDR1) from the Hobby-Eberly Telescope Dark Energy Experiment (HETDEX), covering 6778 observations and $\sim$90 deg$^2$ of sky from January 2017 to July 2024. We detect 527 streaks across 492 observations, a contamination fraction of 7.3% that rises to monthly values above 20% by 2023--2024, although the streaks mask only 0.09% of the survey area. Of the 527 streaks, 475 (90.1%) are identified with a cataloged object using archival two-line elements: 258 (54%) lie in low or Earth orbit and 217 (46%) are geostationary or highly elliptical. Only 35% were launched since 2010; the rest are spent rocket bodies, debris, and older spacecraft. This reflects HETDEX's sensitivity to faint objects and its 2017--2024 observing baseline. The Hobby-Eberly Telescope's large 10\,m aperture and HETDEX's $\sim$6\,minute exposures result in similar observed magnitudes for low Earth orbit (LEO) and geostationary Earth orbit (GEO) objects (median $g_{\rm AB}=16.2\pm1.1$ for LEO, $16.7\pm1.1$ for GEO). However, once transit time is corrected for, instantaneous magnitudes differ widely: $g_{\rm inst}=7.4$ for LEO versus $g_{\rm inst}=13.0$ for GEO objects, a difference of 5.6\,mag, while the exposure-averaged magnitudes differ by only 0.5 mag. Normalized to 550 km, the 34 Starlink streaks give $g(550 {\rm km})=5.95$, consistent with the mean $V(550\,{\rm km})=5.92\pm0.04$ reported for VisorSat-design spacecraft. The spectra are consistent with reflected sunlight, with modest, signal-to-noise-driven differences in slope. The catalog, spectra, and code are archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22962479.
papers.title_ja: HETDEXにおける衛星ストリーク：スペクトル、軌道識別、およびサーベイへの影響
papers.summary_ja: HETDEXの観測データから検出された527本の衛星ストリークについて、分光データベースと軌道識別結果を報告する。低軌道（LEO）と静止軌道（GEO）の物体は、露光時間の影響で平均輝度が似通っているが、瞬時輝度では5.6等級の差があることを示した。また、Starlink衛星の輝度は既存のVisorSat設計の平均値と一致しており、スペクトルは太陽光反射と整合する。この研究は、大口径望遠鏡によるサーベイにおける人工衛星による汚染の定量的評価と、軌道要素を用いた識別手法の検証に焦点を当てている。

papers.title: Model-Based Imitation Learning For Monocular Vision-Based Navigation
papers.summary: Reliable navigation with a single monocular limited field-of-view camera is challenging because the lack of depth measurements and limited spatial awareness complicate collision checking. Existing approaches to tackle these challenges fall into two categories. Model-based planners can incorporate explicit collision-avoidance guidance which leads to better generalization but are often computationally expensive and require manual tuning of the algorithmic parameters. In contrast, end-to-end approaches trained by imitation learning can be flexible but typically encode safety only implicitly and thus can suffer from high collision rates in novel scenarios. In this paper, we present a middle ground through model-based imitation learning. The model-based part is a learned collision model that can map a sequence of past images and a candidate control sequence to a distribution of worst-case obstacle clearance. This predictive distribution in turn is used to define a collision-risk cost in a trajectory optimization formulation. The imitation component uses human demonstrations to learn scene-dependent balancing of collision risk with other task costs such as goal progress. We also use it to learn the algorithmic parameters (e.g., a warm start) of our optimizer to accelerate the solution process. We show that our approach can demonstrate highly reliable navigation in cluttered environments on robots with different embodiments. We also demonstrate a substantial reduction in collision rate over recent end-to-end and model-based baselines.
papers.title_ja: 単眼視覚ベースのナビゲーションのためのモデルベース模倣学習
papers.summary_ja: 単眼カメラによるナビゲーションにおいて、モデルベース計画の計算コストとエンドツーエンド手法の安全性不足を解決するため、モデルベース模倣学習を提案する。学習された衝突モデルが過去画像と候補制御から最悪ケースの障害物クリアランス分布を予測し、軌道最適化における衝突リスクコストとして利用する。模倣学習により、人間デモからシーン依存のコストバランスや最適化パラメータを学習し、計算を高速化する。多様なロボット形態で、既存手法より大幅に衝突率を低減しつつ高信頼なナビゲーションを実現した。

papers.title: Detecting space objects with Earth-observation radar satellites
papers.summary: Millimetre-to-centimetre orbital debris poses a hazard to spacecraft, but its abundance remains difficult to measure. Spaceborne radars offer a substantial sensitivity advantage at close range: received echo power decreases with the fourth power of distance, so an otherwise identical object ten times closer produces a 10,000 times stronger echo. We investigate this opportunity using openly available Sentinel-1 radar voltages recorded on six calendar days. Catalogue-assisted processing identifies a manually validated sample of 76 objects at ranges of 41.7--492.9 km, including satellites, rocket bodies and debris fragments. A blind search recovers two selected debris transits without using their orbital predictions during detection. A short debris encounter also demonstrates how precise range and Doppler measurements can refine a catalogue orbit. Ground scatter increases the effective background and is the principal sensitivity limitation in Earth-looking observations. An ideal receiver-noise sensitivity comparison predicts detectable conducting-sphere diameters of approximately 3.4 mm for Sentinel-1 and 0.6 mm for EarthCARE at 10 km range, assuming coherent integration limited by beam transit time and a 10 ms cap. These results establish the feasibility of space-object detection using existing Earth-observation radars and motivate statistical debris surveys and targeted orbit refinement following collision warnings. Observations directed away from Earth and receive windows adapted to nearby objects could improve sensitivity to small debris.
papers.title_ja: 地球観測レーダー衛星による宇宙物体の検出
papers.summary_ja: 地球観測用レーダー衛星（Sentinel-1）のデータを用い、近距離での高感度特性を活かした宇宙デブリや衛星の検出手法を提案する。カタログ情報を用いた処理で76個の物体を識別し、盲検検索によるデブリ通過の検出や、精密な距離・ドップラー測定による軌道精度の向上を実証した。地上散乱が主な感度制限要因であるものの、既存の地球観測レーダーによる宇宙物体検出の現実可能性を示し、統計的なデブリ調査や衝突警告後の軌道補正への応用を促している。

papers.title: FEROM: Frontier Endogenous Reveal-Order Marginal Policy Optimization for Masked Diffusion LMs
papers.summary: Masked diffusion language models generate text by iteratively unmasking positions, with practical samplers often selecting reveal positions from the model's own logits. The reveal order is therefore an endogenous latent variable of the rollout process with an enormous discrete latent space. Policy optimization objectives relying on pre-defined schedules or sampled trajectories introduce either bias or high variance. In this paper, we propose FEROM, Frontier Endogenous Reveal-Order Marginal Policy Optimization, which approximates policy gradients for the rollout-induced marginal response policy of masked diffusion LMs. FEROM derives a Rao-Blackwellized policy-gradient identity over latent reveal orders and expresses the resulting estimator as posterior edge occupancy on a reveal-state DAG. To make marginalization practical, we introduce Frontier Reveal Marginalization, a budgeted estimator that approximates this marginal edge structure by combining CDF-based computation of local probabilities of the endogenous reveal process with frontier expansion of high-mass partial states. Integrated into a GRPO-style objective, FEROM replaces single-path log-scores with a detached token-score surrogate over posterior-relevant reveal edges. Experiments on math and coding tasks show comparable or improved results over existing methods under matched scoring-state budgets. An offline proxy study further shows improved marginal-gradient approximation with increased scoring budgets.
papers.title_ja: FEROM: マスク拡散言語モデルのためのフロンティア内生リビール順序マージナルポリシー最適化
papers.summary_ja: マスク拡散言語モデルにおけるテキスト生成時の「リビール順序（マスク解除順序）」を内生変数として扱い、その巨大な離散空間に対するポリシー勾配を近似する手法FEROMを提案する。従来の事前定義スケジュールや単一軌道サンプリングによるバイアス・分散問題を解決するため、リビール状態DAG上の後験エッジ占有率を用いたRao-Blackwell化された勾配恒等式を導出する。さらに、CDFベースの局所確率計算と高質量部分状態のフロンティア拡張を組み合わせることで、計算予算内でマージナル化を実行可能にする。数学・コーディングタスクでの実験により、既存手法と比較して同等以上の性能と、スコアリング予算増加に伴う勾配近似の改善を実証した。

papers.title: Singular bifurcations in implicit discrete dynamical systems
papers.summary: A periodic orbit of an implicit discrete system can persist when the implicit function theorem no longer guarantees a smooth successor. We develop a joint Lyapunov-Schmidt reduction of the periodic equations and the determinants marking singular transitions. In unrestricted smooth one-parameter families, the generic event is a single evolution fold on a continued orbit. Simultaneous normal forms describe its interactions with saddle-node and period-doubling bifurcations, locating the singular transitions and, under backward regularity, determining the diverging multipliers. The results cover arbitrary periods and periodically non-autonomous systems. Exact realisations and applications to labour-market equilibrium, machining and implicit integration illustrate the theory.
papers.title_ja: 暗黙的な離散力学系における特異分岐
papers.summary_ja: 暗黙的な離散力学系において、暗黙関数定理が適用できなくなる特異点での周期軌道の挙動を解析する。Lyapunov-Schmidt 縮約を用いて、特異遷移を示す行列式と周期方程式を同時に扱い、一般的な事象が単一の進化折りたたみであることを示す。サドルノード分岐や周期倍化分岐との相互作用を正規形により記述し、発散する乗数を決定する。労働市場均衡や機械加工、暗黙的積分への応用を通じて理論を実証する。

papers.title: The Swift/UVOT Observation Campaign of Comet C/2013 US10 (Catalina) and Near-nucleus UV Excess
papers.summary: We present results of a multi-wavelength extended monitoring campaign of dynamically new long-period comet C/2013 US$_{10}$ (Catalina), captured with the Ultraviolet and Optical Telescope (UVOT) on board the Swift spacecraft covering 5.8 AU inbound to 5 AU outbound. The pipeline and methodology developed for these results is introduced, along with derived water production rates, active areas, and dust content proxy $A(\theta)f\rho$. We describe a Bayesian solution to address the unknown spectral gradient $S'$ of the dust of C/2013 US$_{10}$ necessary for our continuum subtraction calculations. The comet exhibited significant hyperactivity, with the water production rate approaching $2.5 \times 10^{29}$/s and a greatly elevated active area pre-perihelion, settling to approximately 50 km$^2$ post-perihelion. We also report and quantify a near-nucleus UV excess beyond vectorial model predictions, a feature we have dubbed the Pale Blue Spot (PBS), and cover possible candidate species responsible. When interpreted as OH (A-X) band fluorescence, the PBS may point to a secondary release mechanism producing slow-moving hydroxyl radicals that is active even beyond the water snow line.
papers.title_ja: 彗星 C/2013 US10 (Catalina) と核近傍の紫外線過剰に関する Swift/UVOT 観測キャンペーン
papers.summary_ja: Swift 衛星の UVOT を用いて、長周期彗星 C/2013 US10 の多波長観測キャンペーンの結果を報告する。水生成率や活動領域の推定に加え、未知の塵スペクトル勾配に対するベイズ推定手法を適用した。彗星は過剰な活動を示し、核近傍で予測を超える紫外線過剰（Pale Blue Spot）を検出。この現象は、水雪線を超えても活性な二次放出メカニズムによる遅い水酸基ラジカルの存在を示唆している。

papers.title: The Physics of Interstellar Travel
papers.summary: How can we send an uncrewed spacecraft to the nearest stars within a human lifetime? What propulsion methods are available? Will it survive impacts in the interstellar medium? What science will it do at its destination? How can it send back data over enormous distances? In this short semi-popular article, I examine various aspects of the physics of interstellar travel, its challenges and possible solutions. I focus on nuclear rockets, laser sails, dust impacts, and communication. These, as well as other issues such as navigation and onboard power, are explored in more detail in my book, The Physics of Interstellar Travel (2026).
papers.title_ja: 恒星間旅行の物理学
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、有人・無人の恒星間探査における物理学的課題と解決策を概説する半通俗的な記事である。核ロケットやレーザーセイルといった推進方式、星間物質との衝突耐性、長距離通信、およびナビゲーションや電源問題について考察している。著者の書籍『The Physics of Interstellar Travel』で詳細が述べられているこれらの技術的・物理的制約を整理し、将来の宇宙機設計への示唆を提供する。

papers.title: Lie-Lions brackets of nonlocal vector fields
papers.summary: We study nonlocal vector fields on the space of probability measures with finite second moment. Using Lions derivatives, we define their Lie-Lions bracket, which adds to the spatial Lie bracket a correction due to the evolution of the law, and prove that its vanishing is equivalent to commutation of the global flows, under first-order regularity and linear growth assumptions. We then construct a Lie algebra of complete polynomial nonlocal fields. For this class, we establish commutator and second-order Baker-Campbell-Hausdorff formulas with cubic remainders in the Wasserstein distance $W_2$, controlled by the second moment and uniform in the number of particles. The proofs rely on finite-particle realizations, which preserve the bracket and jointly determine the nonlocal field. We also obtain uniform estimates for smooth bounded kernels and a Leibniz rule for the action of polynomial fields on polynomial observables. Examples from collective dynamics show that the vanishing of the spatial bracket at a fixed law is neither necessary nor sufficient for commutation. They concern symmetries, aggregation-dependent rotation, synchronization, the transmission of a turn along a hierarchy, effective three-body interactions and occupancy-dependent circulation.
papers.title_ja: 非局所ベクトル場のリー・リオン括弧
papers.summary_ja: 有限二階モーメントを持つ確率測度の空間における非局所ベクトル場について、リオン微分を用いてリー・リオン括弧を定義し、その消失がグローバルフローの可換性と等価であることを証明した。完全多項式非局所場のリー代数を構成し、ウォーターシュタイン距離 $W_2$ における交換子および2次ベーカー・キャンベル・ハウスドルフ公式を導出した。有限粒子実現による証明手法を用い、集団動態における対称性や同期化などの具体例を通じて、空間括弧の消失と可換性の関係を明確にした。

papers.title: Forward and pullback attraction under worst-case and ergodic exponents in a predator-prey model with bounded random refuge
papers.summary: We consider a predator-prey system with logistic prey, Holling type II response and a prey refuge fluctuating randomly within a band, driven by a bounded transformation of an Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process. Bounded noise yields a deterministic compact set attracting forward uniformly in the realisation, alongside the random pullback attractor, and we compare the two. The smallest such deterministic set, the minimal uniform attracting set, is the kernel of the control system in which the accessible fraction is any measurable band-valued function, and it meets the coexistence region exactly when the upper worst-case invasion exponent of the predator is positive, whereas the pullback attractor is governed by the ergodic invasion exponent, which decides the predator's fate pathwise. When the predator becomes extinct, the closure of the union of the fibres of the pullback attractor equals the minimal uniform attracting set if and only if the upper worst-case exponent is nonpositive, and otherwise the inclusion is strict and the latter is invariant under no realisation. When the predator persists, the essential closure of the union of the fibres contains, for every frozen environment in which the predator invades, the equilibrium or a periodic orbit of the frozen system, and every state the control system can reach from them. The predator is uniformly persistent when the lower worst-case exponent is positive and almost surely not when it is negative. The ergodic exponent lies below its deterministic counterpart by an amount comparable to the curvature of the response times the variance of the accessible fraction.
papers.title_ja: 有界ランダム避難所を持つ捕食者-被食者モデルにおける最悪ケースとエルゴード指数に基づく前方および引き戻しアトラクター
papers.summary_ja: 有界なランダムノイズが加わった捕食者-被食者システムにおいて、決定論的な最小一様アトラクターと確率的な引き戻しアトラクターの関係を解析した。最悪ケース侵入指数とエルゴード侵入指数を用いて、捕食者の絶滅または持続の条件を導出し、両アトラクターの包含関係や構造の違いを明確にした。エルゴード指数は決定論的指数より、応答関数の曲率とアクセス可能割合の分散に比例する量だけ小さいことを示した。

papers.title: Ejecta fate and deposition in the Didymos-Dimorphos system after the DART impact
papers.summary: Kinetic impact is a promising technique for asteroid deflection in planetary defense. The NASA Double Asteroid Redirection Test (DART) spacecraft collided with Dimorphos, the satellite of the binary asteroid (65803) Didymos, at 6.1449 km s^{-1} in 2022. Observations revealed changes in both the orbit of Dimorphos around Didymos and the heliocentric orbit of the Didymos-Dimorphos system. The ESA Hera spacecraft will arrive at the system at the end of 2026 to investigate the post-impact surfaces. Here, we present an analytical model, based on Maxwell's Z model, to predict ejecta behavior following the DART impact. The model provides the relationships among ejection velocity, ejection angle, and ejecta mass, allowing the momentum enhancement factor beta to be estimated for both Dimorphos and the Didymos-Dimorphos system. We show that the observed beta can be reproduced when 0.3-1% of the impact kinetic energy is converted into ejecta kinetic energy and the effective strength of the target is less than 100 Pa. The escaping mass is estimated to be 0.3-3.0% of the mass of Dimorphos. The globally averaged and minimum ejecta thicknesses on Dimorphos are estimated to be 2.0 m and 0.5 m, respectively, indicating that the entire surface was resurfaced by ejecta deposition, although boulders larger than 1 m were only partially buried. The model also predicts the momentum partition parameter kappa_p to be as low as 0.6, suggesting that the mass and the bulk density of Dimorphos may be revised upward. These predictions provide quantitative constraints for interpreting forthcoming Hera observations.
papers.title_ja: DART衝突後のディディモス-ディモルフォス系における飛散物の運命と堆積
papers.summary_ja: 小惑星ディモルフォスへのDART衝突後の飛散物挙動を、MaxwellのZモデルに基づいた解析モデルで予測した。衝突運動エネルギーの0.3〜1%が飛散物運動エネルギーに変換され、有効強度が100Pa未満である場合、観測された運動量増強係数βを再現できることを示した。ディモルフォスの表面は厚さ0.5〜2.0mの飛散物で再形成されたと推定される。これらの予測は、2026年末に到着予定のESAヘラ探査機による観測解釈のための定量的制約を与える。

papers.title: Bulgarian solitaire with distinguishable cells
papers.summary: Classical Bulgarian solitaire tracks only the sizes of the stacks. We ask how the lengths of its periodic orbits change when individual cards are distinguished. To study this question, we introduce four actions $T_1,T_2,T_3,T_4$ on partitions with labeled cells. The actions differ in whether the top or bottom cell is removed from each column and in the order in which the removed cells are arranged to form a new column. We determine the exact sizes of the periodic orbits for all four actions. The main work lies in the analysis of $T_2$, for which we develop a coloring algorithm on Ferrers diagrams. The coloring encodes the cycle structure of the permutation of the labels induced by one full period of the underlying partition.
papers.title_ja: 区別可能なセルを持つブルガリアンソリテール
papers.summary_ja: 古典的なブルガリアンソリテールではスタックのサイズのみを追跡するが、本論文では個々のカード（セル）を区別した場合の周期軌道の長さを分析する。ラベル付きセルを持つ分割に対して4つの操作を定義し、それぞれの周期軌道の正確なサイズを決定した。特に操作T2の解析において、フェラー図上のカラーリングアルゴリズムを開発し、ラベルの置換構造を符号化することで周期構造を解明した。

papers.title: Robust Satisficing Ensemble: Scalable Model Aggregation Under Distribution Shifts
papers.summary: Standard ensemble methods can improve robustness by mitigating individual model stochasticity, but they frequently fail to generalize beyond the training distribution, leaving systems vulnerable to out-of-distribution (OOD) data. We introduce the Robust Satisficing Ensemble (RSE), a scalable probabilistic aggregation framework designed to secure model combinations by minimizing their fragility against distributional changes. By bridging a robust satisficing objective with a quadratic risk surrogate, RSE derives an analytical inner adversary. This fundamental reformulation enables highly efficient weight updates without the computational bottleneck of standard minimax optimization, crucially decoupling optimization complexity from sample size to scale effectively to large datasets. In particular, we prove a geometrically decaying truncation error for the fragility approximation via Lagrange-Burmann expansion and establish stationarity guarantees for RSE. We evaluate RSE across a comprehensive spectrum of distribution shifts, including adversarial label shift (SST-5, TREC), natural subpopulation and temporal shifts (CivilComments, HuffPost). Our results demonstrate that RSE consistently outperforms strong robust baselines, including GroupDRO, IRM, and SRM. These findings establish RSE as a practical, theoretically grounded safeguard for reliable model aggregation in dynamic environments.

papers.title: CoupledFlow: One-Step Neural Operators for Coupled Multi-Physics PDEs
papers.summary: This paper introduces COUPLED FLOW, a new neural operator learning framework for multi-physics PDE systems that captures the co-evolution of multiple physical processes by modeling their cross-process interactions. Unlike existing neural operator methods that primarily target single-physics settings, COUPLED FLOW employs a novel structure-constrained flow matching algorithm to learn process- specific mean velocity fields conditioned on the full multi-physics state. This enables fast and accurate one-step prediction of coupled PDE systems that would otherwise require expensive numerical simulations. A key challenge in training COUPLED FLOW however lies in sampling structure-constrained conditional flow interpolants that capture cross-process correlations and serve as training examples for flow matching. To address this challenge, we derive a multi-physics mean-flow consistency identity that characterizes cross-process interactions and defines the structure-constrained mean-flow matching loss. To provide informative training samples for flow matching with this loss, we develop a principled method for sampling correlated conditional interpolants based on posterior multi-output Gaus- sian processes, which capture richer cross-process correlations than the commonly used endpoint-conditioned linear interpolants. We also establish a theoretical re- sult showing that the Wasserstein-2 distance between the predicted and oracle PDE solution distributions is upper-bounded in terms of the structure-constrained flow matching loss and the smoothness of the learned flow. Experiments across diverse coupled PDE benchmarks demonstrate that COUPLED FLOW consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art neural operators and generative PDE solvers.

papers.title: ALETHEIA: A Multi-Frequency Eddy Current Pulsed Thermography Dataset for Neural Operator Learning in Nondestructive Testing
papers.summary: Learning neural solvers for spatiotemporal partial differential equations (PDEs) under real-world constraints remains a key challenge in scientific machine learning, especially for inverse tasks with sparse and noisy boundary observations. We present the Aletheia dataset, the first 3D benchmark for learning data-driven solvers in the context of nondestructive testing (NDT). The dataset simulates eddy-current-induced heating in conductive solids and models the resulting transient heat propagation governed by the heat equation. Aletheia contains over 4,700 high-resolution samples across 10 excitation frequencies (1-100,kHz), each providing volumetric heat source and temperature fields over time. It supports both forward prediction of temperature evolution and inverse reconstruction of internal heat sources or defects from surface infrared measurements. Real infrared thermography data from cracked rail specimens are included for calibration and comparison. We define four canonical tasks on both regular and irregular grids and benchmark them using various neural operators. Aletheia establishes a unified platform for evaluating neural PDE solvers under realistic NDT conditions, enabling progress in reliable, data-driven inverse modeling. The dataset and code are publicly available at https://github.com/sherlock-0327/ALETHEIA.

papers.title: Boundary Mass in Feature Space as a Label-Budget Diagnostic for Representations
papers.summary: Low-label transfer is often decided by a practical question: after a representation looks useful, how many labels are still needed to learn the downstream boundary? Transferability and probe-quality scores characterize global alignment, likelihood, margins, and calibration. Boundary-near target mass complements these diagnostics by measuring the ambiguous regions where scarce labels are most costly. We propose effective boundary complexity, a label-budget diagnostic for frozen representations and linear probes. It measures mass in a thin strip around the learned boundary and normalizes it by class balance, so dense ambiguous regions and predicted-class imbalance are both counted. We prove that, under a smooth representation map, density change and tangential surface change cancel at first order, leaving boundary-normal stretch or compression as the governing factor. This yields a cached-feature estimator that fits a probe on one split and counts independent held-out features near its boundary. Experiments support the diagnostic at three levels. Controlled transformations match the predicted law across 74 maps with 0.38% median relative error. On real frozen features, normal-direction changes move both measured boundary mass and label demand, while tangent controls preserve the first-order coefficient. A differentiable surrogate reduces measured complexity by 16-36% at matched top-1 utility. Finally, CIFAR-100 and Tiny-ImageNet experiments support boundary mass as a second-stage diagnostic for near-tied representations. Five-way experiments show strong OvR-interface backbone-ranking agreement (Spearman 0.872), while acquisition experiments show high correlations between initial boundary mass and realized label budgets across three sampling policies (0.779-0.830). Code is available at https://github.com/qqaqq-code/boundary_mass.

papers.title: Building heterogeneous multistep workflows in automated microscopy: reward design and knowledge transfer for autonomous structure property discovery
papers.summary: Autonomous microscopy can turn fast acquisition into scientific progress when it decides not only where to measure, but also what information to acquire, at what scan rate, and when to recalibrate the instrument. We develop a budget constrained framework for such multistep structure-property workflows. It combines explicit scientific rewards, action costs, instrument observation models, transfer of pre experiment knowledge into the online campaign, and evaluation kept independent of the controller. The transferred knowledge includes predictor accuracy and computational cost, empirical learner maturity functions that weight model-derived rewards, and drift characteristics established before controller training. Using a real electron energy-loss spectroscopy dataset, we run two complementary campaigns. In the first, the controller chooses between imaging and spectroscopy, image size, and scan speed. In the second, the instrument drifts and the controller also decides when to recalibrate. The campaigns show that response discovery and structure-property learning favor different surrogate models and acquisition strategies. They also show that simple acquisition rules form strong, practical baselines. Independent error analysis reveals where model uncertainty is and is not a reliable learning signal. In the drift campaign, explicit registration greatly improves positional accuracy, and the framework measures what this costs in spectroscopy throughput. Together, these results provide a reproducible way to design, compare, and audit autonomous experiments, and they define what microscopes must provide for deployment: independently executable actions, characterized scan and detector responses, timestamped registration telemetry, and complete action records.

papers.title: Operator Learning of Microstructure-Dependent Internal-Variable Models for Inelastic Homogenization: Approximation and Complexity
papers.summary: We study the learning of homogenized constitutive laws for inelastic heterogeneous materials, aiming to replace costly concurrent unit-cell simulations with surrogates that generalize across loading histories and microstructures. We focus on the recurrent neural operator framework, motivated by the explicit form of homogenized Kelvin--Voigt linear viscoelasticity. In this framework, internal variables enable a Markovian approximation of loading-history dependence, and neural operators represent the microstructure-dependent constitutive response. For periodic Kelvin--Voigt viscoelasticity, we prove a universal approximation theorem showing that the model can approximate the homogenized constitutive law to any prescribed accuracy, uniformly in time and over a wide set of admissible strain trajectories and microstructural property fields, in two and three dimensions. This comprises a significant extension of the existing, somewhat limited, one-dimensional theory that uses explicit solutions for piecewise constant materials. Instead, in two and three dimensions, we adopt a more versatile approximation based on the spectral representation of the memory kernel that arises from homogenization. This also enables us to give an explicit bound on the internal-variable dimension, sufficient for approximation, exhibiting logarithmic growth in the inverse relative stress error and in material contrast. Numerical experiments on viscoelasticity and crystal plasticity complement the theory, illustrating the roles of internal-variable dimension and sample complexity in learning homogenized responses from unit-cell data. Theoretical results are formally verified in Lean 4.

papers.title: When Does Physics Beat Data? Data-Efficient Traffic State Estimation with Amortized PINNs
papers.summary: Traffic state estimation (TSE) reconstructs traffic density at unmonitored locations from a sparse set of sensors. Data-driven models work well when sensors are dense but degrade sharply as coverage thins. We show that imposing the Lighthill-Whitham-Richards conservation law as a physics-informed prior makes TSE more data-efficient. On four real corridors (NGSIM, I-80, PeMS04, PeMS08), physics-informed estimators generalise to held-out sensors where data-driven models, including classical and deep kriging, overfit the observed ones. On the two shock-rich corridors the effect is a clear crossover: as more sensors are held out, data-driven models collapse while the physics-informed estimator degrades gracefully, leading the no-physics network by about 26-38% at 85-90% held out and the strongest classical kriging by about 10-21% at 90%. A matched smoothness prior does not reproduce the gain, and an extended Kalman filter on the same LWR model is outperformed on the shock corridors, so the advantage comes from how the conservation law is imposed. Finally, one loss-conditional PINN removes the per-corridor loss-weight search, matching a 20-point search at about 5x lower cost.

papers.title: On the Global Convergence of Stochastic Adam for Physics-Informed Neural Networks
papers.summary: The Adam optimizer is widely used to train neural networks with highly nonlinear and nonconvex objective functions. Remarkably, Adam often drives the empirical training loss nearly to zero. This phenomenon has been partially explained by neural tangent kernel (NTK) analyses of gradient descent (GD) and stochastic gradient descent (SGD). However, analyzing Adam presents additional challenges. Its first-moment momentum couples stochastic gradients across iterations, while its adaptive second-moment preconditioner depends on the same stochastic gradient used in the update. In this paper, we establish linear convergence guarantees for Adam in training sufficiently wide two-layer neural networks with either full-batch or minibatch gradients. For full-batch Adam, we construct a Lyapunov function to control the effect of historical momentum. For minibatch Adam, our analysis builds on an exact virtual-iterate representation, a conditional analysis of the dependence between stochastic gradients and adaptive preconditioners, and uniform concentration bounds for the second-moment estimates. We prove geometric decay of the empirical loss for full-batch Adam and geometric decay in restricted expectation on a high-probability event for minibatch Adam. Beyond regression, we extend our convergence analysis to physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) for solving the Poisson equation, where differential operators and separate sampling of interior and boundary points introduce additional challenges. We establish analogous global convergence guarantees for both deterministic and stochastic Adam under explicit conditions on network width and Adam's parameters, characterizing the effects of minibatch size on convergence. These results help bridge the gap between Adam's empirical success and its theoretical understanding, providing sharper convergence guarantees for PINNs than existing analyses.

papers.title: Constrained Variational Policy Optimization for Hybrid Action Spaces
papers.summary: Constrained reinforcement learning in hybrid action spaces must coordinate discrete modes and mode-conditioned continuous controls under long-horizon cost constraints. Existing constrained hybrid-action methods typically optimize factorized policies directly in parameter space, whereas Constrained Variational Policy Optimization (CVPO) separates nonparametric improvement from parametric projection in its original continuous-action formulation. We introduce Hybrid Constrained Variational Policy Optimization (H-CVPO), extending this variational framework to hybrid action spaces. Under boundedness and strict feasibility, its constrained E-step has zero duality gap and, when the dual optimum is attained at positive temperature, yields a closed-form joint target distribution over hybrid actions through exponential reward-cost reweighting. Using the exact hybrid KL decomposition, we formulate a factorized M-step that fits both policy components to this target under separate discrete and conditional-continuous trust regions. For exact E/M updates, we prove fixed-reference surrogate improvement and conditional reward-cost bounds with a sufficient feasibility-margin condition. For approximate updates, we establish the existence of a dual minimizer under continuity on a compact domain and use residual-based admissibility to determine whether to project the target. Ablations identify cost-aware reweighting as an important contributor to constraint control. Extensive experiments in simulated hybrid-control environments show that H-CVPO achieves favorable reward-cost trade-offs compared with hybrid-action baselines.

papers.title: Decision Aware Origin-Destination Demand Estimation with Structurally Constrained Data
papers.summary: Origin-destination (OD) demand plays an important role in transportation system design and management applications. Conventional OD estimation methods typically judge estimation quality based on how estimated demand aligns with observed traffic data and historical demand patterns. We argue that data alignment alone is insufficient; how errors in OD estimates influence downstream decision quality should also be considered. This paper develops a decision aware OD demand estimation framework that leverages structurally constrained traffic data to characterize an admissible demand region, within which we identify OD estimates that would lead to least regret in the downstream decision. Therefore, our OD estimates are both data-consistent and decision-relevant. Methodologically, we approximate the admissible demand region induced by physical network constraints through a geometric representation, which regularizes the search over feasible OD estimates. Within this regularized region, we use a convex surrogate of downstream regret to obtain a tractable decision aware optimization problem. Numerical experiments show that the proposed framework consistently reduces decision regret relative to conventional estimation benchmarks, demonstrating the value of aligning OD demand estimation with downstream decision quality.

papers.title: Beyond Prediction Residuals: Conformal Regret Calibration for Robust Contextual Linear Optimization
papers.summary: Predict-then-optimize systems convert contextual forecasts into decisions, yet conformal robust optimization typically calibrates prediction residuals rather than downstream loss. For linear optimization, this parameter-space geometry can be badly misaligned with decision risk: large objective perturbations may preserve the optimizer, while small boundary-crossing perturbations may cause substantial regret. We introduce Conformal Regret Sets, a post-hoc, model-agnostic framework that conformalizes an optimization-derived regret surrogate and uses its calibrated level set for minimax-regret refinement. We first show that directly conformalizing exact regret, although sufficient to certify the nominal predict-then-optimize decision, yields a degenerate robust problem: absent an exogenous bounded support, every alternative decision has unbounded worst-case regret. We therefore use SPO+, a pointwise upper bound on exact regret, as the conformal score, obtaining distribution-free finite-sample marginal regret guarantees under exchangeability. For contextual linear programs, the resulting set decomposes into polyhedral pieces aligned with the normal fan of the feasible polytope. A vertex is active if and only if its predicted suboptimality gap is at most half the calibrated threshold $\eta$, enabling local, output-sensitive generation of all relevant pieces.
